server.usage:
Usage: cohive-server <command>

Service:
  migrate                                         Run database migrations
  serve [--addr :8787]                            Start the Cohive server (board, plus group notification delivery)

Server settings:
  server show                                     Show the external URL
  server set --external-url <url>                 Set the external URL (used for links in group messages and the MCP hostname), for example https://cohive.example.com;
                                                  pass an empty string to clear it; when COHIVE_EXTERNAL_URL is set it wins and cannot be changed here

Workspaces (one project and one chat group per workspace; the path is fixed, the display name can be changed):
  workspace add --name <path> [--display <display name>] [--admin <username>]
                                                  Create a workspace and name its first admin
  workspace set --name <path> --display <display name>
                                                  Change the display name (an empty string resets it to the path)
  workspace set --name <path> --remind-open-hours <hours> --remind-verify-hours <hours>
                                                  Overdue reminder delays (defaults 4 and 24; 0 turns them off)
  workspace set --name <path> --language <code>  Language of group notifications and bot replies in the group (e.g. en, zh-CN; empty follows the server default)
  workspace remove --name <path>                  Delete a workspace (only if it has no issues)
  workspace list                                  List workspaces and their group notification settings
  workspace notify --workspace <path> --telegram-chat <chat ID (send /chatid in the chat to get it)>
  workspace notify --workspace <path> --dingtalk-chat <DingTalk chat ID (mention the bot in the chat and send "chatid")>
  workspace notify --workspace <path> --slack-chat <Slack channel ID (mention the bot in the channel and send "chatid")>
      [--show-title=false] [--show-brief=false]   Configure group notifications; --off turns them off; a chat can be bound to only one workspace
  notify test --workspace <name>                  Send a test message to the workspace's chat group
  notify retry --workspace <name>                 Requeue notifications that failed to send

Accounts (one per server; for everyday management use "Admin" and "Server admin" in the web UI):
  account list [--prefix <username prefix>]       List accounts, their workspaces and device counts
  account set --name <username> [--display <display name>] [--telegram <username>] [--telegram-id <ID>]
                                                  Change the display name; register a Telegram username (for mentions) or user ID
  account disable --name <username>               Deactivate: revoke all devices and tokens, sign out of the web UI, disconnect Telegram
  account enable --name <username>                Re-enable (devices are not restored; pair again and have an admin approve)
  account server-admin --name <username> --on|--off
                                                  Grant or revoke server admin
  admin reset-password --name <username>          Reset the web password; the new password is shown only once here and must be changed after signing in

Admin audit log (read-only; the web UI has a "Log" tab under "Admin" and "Server admin"):
  audit list [--workspace <name>] [--type <category>] [--actor <username>] [--via <entry point>] [--limit 50] [--before <ID>]
                                                  List admin audit log entries, newest first

Membership, tokens, services and issues (all accept --workspace <name>, default is "default"):
  member add --name <username> [--display <display name>] [--role admin]
                                                  Add an account to the workspace; creates it if it does not exist (no password)
  member set --name <username> --role admin|member
                                                  Set the role (at least one admin must remain)
  member remove --name <username> --handover-to <username> --as <admin username>
                                                  Remove: open issues and services go to the successor, tokens are revoked
  member list [--all]                             List members (--all includes removed ones)
  token issue --member <username> --tool <tool>   Issue a token for one of a member's tools (shown only once)
  token list                                      List tokens
  token revoke --id <ID>                          Revoke a token
  service add --name <service> --owner <username> Register a service owner (updates it if the service exists)
  service list                                    List services
  issue cancel --id <ID> --reason <reason> --as <admin username>
                                                  Cancel an issue (any in progress); the reporter and owner are notified; cannot be undone

Environment variables:
  COHIVE_DATABASE_URL          Database URL (required)
  COHIVE_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN    Telegram bot token (required for group notifications)
  COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID    Client ID of the DingTalk internal app; set it together with COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET to enable DingTalk
  COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET Client Secret of the DingTalk app
  COHIVE_DINGTALK_NOTICE_TEMPLATE, COHIVE_DINGTALK_APPROVAL_TEMPLATE  IDs of the DingTalk notice and approval card templates (optional; degraded without them)
  COHIVE_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN       Slack bot token (starts with xoxb-); set it together with COHIVE_SLACK_APP_TOKEN to enable Slack
  COHIVE_SLACK_APP_TOKEN       Slack app-level token (starts with xapp-, with connections:write)
  COHIVE_EXTERNAL_URL          External URL (optional); when set it is locked and the web UI and CLI cannot change it
  COHIVE_ALLOWED_HOSTS         Extra hostnames allowed for MCP access through tunnels and the like, comma-separated
  COHIVE_DATA_DIR              Data directory (default ./data); the initial admin password is written here on first start
  COHIVE_DEFAULT_LANGUAGE      Server default language (en or zh-CN): used for errors when the web UI gives no language, for MCP and for group notifications; English if unset
  COHIVE_LANG                  Language of this command line's output (en or zh-CN); follows the system language if unset
server.database_url_missing: environment variable COHIVE_DATABASE_URL is not set
server.table.members: ID	Username	Display name	Role	Status	Telegram username	Telegram ID
server.table.tokens: ID	Member	Tool	Issued at	Status
server.table.workspaces: ID	Path	Display name	Group notifications	Pending/failed
server.table.accounts: Username	Display name	Server admin	Status	Telegram	Devices	Workspaces
server.workspace.not_found_hint: workspace {{.Name}} does not exist; create it with workspace add
server.workspace.nothing_to_change: Nothing to change: use --display (the path cannot be changed), --remind-open-hours, --remind-verify-hours or --language
server.workspace.notify_dingtalk: Group notifications for workspace {{.Name}} go to DingTalk chat {{.Chat}}
server.workspace.notify_slack: Group notifications for workspace {{.Name}} go to Slack channel {{.Chat}}
server.workspace.chat_conflict: use only one of --telegram-chat, --dingtalk-chat and --slack-chat, and don't combine it with --off
server.workspace.chat_missing: missing argument --telegram-chat, --dingtalk-chat or --slack-chat; use --off to turn group notifications off
server.workspace.telegram_chat_invalid: the Telegram chat ID must be a number, for example -1001234567890
server.workspace.public_url_removed: --public-url has been removed: the external URL is now server-wide and set only once, use cohive-server server set --external-url {{.URL}}
server.workspace.notify_off: Turned off group notifications for workspace {{.Name}}
server.workspace.notify_telegram: Group notifications for workspace {{.Name}} go to Telegram chat {{.Chat}}
server.member.role_invalid: the role must be admin or member, got {{.Role}}
server.member.created: Created account {{.Name}} and added it to the workspace (member ID {{.ID}}). The account has no password yet; generate one with admin reset-password
server.member.added: Added account {{.Name}} to the workspace (member ID {{.ID}})
server.member.not_found_or_removed: member {{.Name}} does not exist or has been removed
server.member.handover_not_member: successor {{.Name}} is not a member of this workspace
server.member.removed: Removed {{.Name}}: handed {{.Issues}} issue(s) and {{.Services}} service(s) over to {{.To}}; their tokens in this workspace are revoked
server.member.telegram_moved: Telegram connections are now per account and shared across workspaces: use account set --name {{.Name}} --telegram ...
server.member.nothing_to_change: nothing to change: use --role to set the role
server.token.issued:
Issued a token for {{.Member}}'s {{.Tool}} (ID {{.ID}}). The token is shown only once, keep it safe:
{{.Token}}
server.token.not_found: token {{.ID}} does not exist, is already revoked, or does not belong to this workspace
server.account.telegram_username_invalid: Telegram username {{.Name}} is invalid: 5 to 32 characters, starting with a letter, only letters, digits and underscores
server.account.telegram_id_invalid: the Telegram user ID must be a positive integer; send /whoami to the bot in a private chat to find it
server.account.telegram_id_set: {{.Name}} is now linked to Telegram user ID {{.ID}}
server.account.telegram_id_cleared: Unlinked the Telegram user ID of {{.Name}}
server.account.disabled: Deactivated {{.Name}}: all devices and tokens revoked, web sessions signed out, Telegram disconnected
server.account.enabled: Re-enabled {{.Name}}. Devices are not restored: they need to run cohive login again and have an admin approve
server.account.on_off_required: use --on to grant or --off to revoke
server.server.only_set_show: server only supports set and show
server.external_url.unset: External URL: not set (group messages carry no links)
server.external_url.locked: External URL: {{.URL}} (locked by the COHIVE_EXTERNAL_URL environment variable)
server.external_url.applied: A running Cohive server picks this up within 30 seconds
server.notify.dingtalk_id_missing: COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET is set but COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID (the DingTalk app's Client ID) is missing
server.notify.dingtalk_secret_missing: COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID is set but COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET (the DingTalk app's Client Secret) is missing
server.notify.no_credentials: no chat app credentials are set: the Telegram bot token COHIVE_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, the DingTalk app credentials COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID and COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET, or the Slack tokens COHIVE_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and COHIVE_SLACK_APP_TOKEN
server.notify.telegram_token_missing: environment variable COHIVE_TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (Telegram bot token) is not set
server.notify.dingtalk_credentials_missi: the DingTalk app credentials COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID and COHIVE_DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET are not set
server.notify.slack_credentials_missing: the Slack tokens COHIVE_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and COHIVE_SLACK_APP_TOKEN are not set
server.notify.slack_bot_token_missing: COHIVE_SLACK_APP_TOKEN is set but COHIVE_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN (the Slack bot token, starting with xoxb-) is missing
server.notify.slack_app_token_missing: COHIVE_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN is set but COHIVE_SLACK_APP_TOKEN (the Slack app-level token, starting with xapp-) is missing
server.notify.slack_tokens_swapped: the two Slack tokens look swapped: COHIVE_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN should be the bot token starting with xoxb-, COHIVE_SLACK_APP_TOKEN the app-level token starting with xapp-
server.notify.not_configured: workspace {{.Name}} has no group notifications yet: for a Telegram chat, send /chatid in the chat to get its ID, then run workspace notify --workspace {{.Name}} --telegram-chat <chat ID>; for a DingTalk chat, generate a binding code under Admin > Workspace in the web UI, then mention the bot in the chat and send "bindgroup <binding code>"; for a Slack channel, do the same with a binding code from the web UI, mentioning the bot in the channel
server.notify.test_text: Cohive test message: group notifications for workspace {{.Name}} are connected. From now on, whoever should handle an issue gets mentioned here.
server.notify.test_sent: Sent a test message to the chat group of workspace {{.Name}}

server.notify.retried.one: Requeued {{.Count}} failed notification for workspace {{.Name}}; the server resends within a few seconds (issues that have moved on since are skipped)
server.notify.retried.other: Requeued {{.Count}} failed notifications for workspace {{.Name}}; the server resends within a few seconds (issues that have moved on since are skipped)

server.flag.username_unique: Username (unique across the server; used to sign in and for assignments)
server.flag.display_new_account: Display name (used when creating the account)
server.flag.remove_username: Username of the member to remove
server.flag.handover_to: Successor's username: open issues and services are handed over to them
server.flag.as_admin: Username of a workspace admin to record as the actor
server.flag.tool: Tool name, for example claude-code, codex or opencode
server.flag.ws_path_add: Workspace path, used in links and project config, usually one project (one chat group); cannot be changed once created
server.flag.ws_display_add: Display name (optional, can be changed any time; defaults to the path)
server.flag.ws_display_set: Display name; pass an empty string to reset it to the path
server.flag.telegram_chat: Telegram chat ID (send /chatid in the chat to get it)
server.flag.dingtalk_chat: DingTalk chat ID (mention the bot in the chat and send "chatid"; you can also bind with a binding code in the web UI)
server.flag.slack_chat: Slack channel ID (mention the bot in the channel and send "chatid"; you can also bind with a binding code in the web UI)
server.flag.show_title: Show the title in group messages
server.flag.show_brief: Show the group notification brief in group messages
server.flag.public_url: Removed: the external URL is now server-wide, use server set --external-url
server.flag.role_set: Role: admin (can send invites, approve sign-ups and devices) or member
server.flag.telegram_username: Telegram username, used to mention the person in group notifications; pass an empty string to clear
server.flag.telegram_id: Telegram user ID (send /whoami to the bot in a private chat), used to recognize who taps an approval button in a chat; pass an empty string to unlink. Usually the person connects it themselves under Profile in the web UI
server.flag.audit_via: Entry point: web, telegram, server_cli, member_cli, agent (coding tool token), system, unknown
server.flag.audit_before: Only entries with an ID below this one (paging)
server.flag.external_url: External URL, for example https://cohive.example.com (no path); pass an empty string to clear
server.flag.remind_open_hours: Hours an issue can wait to be accepted before a reminder (0 turns reminders off)
server.flag.remind_verify_hours: Hours an issue can wait for verification before a reminder (0 turns reminders off)
server.workspace.settings_set: Workspace {{.Name}}: display name {{.Display}}, overdue reminders: waiting to be accepted {{.Open}}, waiting for verification {{.Verify}}
server.flag.ws_language: Language code for group messages (for example en or zh-CN); an empty string follows the server default
server.flag.cancel_reason: Reason for cancelling; the reporter, the owner and the activity show it
server.issue.cancelled: Cancelled #{{.ID}} ({{.Title}}); the reporter and owner were notified
server.issue.as_not_admin: --as must be an active admin of this workspace: {{.Name}}
